items.followUp: Write the formula for kinetic energy and state what each symbol represents.

rubric.why: Identifies motion as the cause of the body's kinetic energy.
rubric.description: Defines kinetic energy as energy possessed due to motion.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for linking a body's energy to its motion.

rubric.why: Gives the standard formula for kinetic energy.
rubric.description: Writes the kinetic energy formula, KE = ½mv².
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for the correct formula.

modelAnswer: Kinetic energy is the energy possessed by a body due to its motion.

items.followUp: What happens to the shape of an elastic body when the deforming force is removed?

rubric.why: States the recovery that characterises an elastic body.
rubric.description: States that the body regains its original shape or size.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that the body returns to its original shape or size.

rubric.why: States when the recovery takes place.
rubric.description: States that recovery occurs when the deforming force is removed.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for specifying removal of the deforming force.

modelAnswer: Elasticity is the property of a body by which it regains its original shape and size when the deforming force is removed.
